Definition: green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
BiblicalUsage: 1) fresh, young barley ears, barley; 2) month of ear-forming, of greening of crop, of growing green Abib, month of exodus and passover (March or April)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
